### Version

Merging this releases a new version (unless the box above is ticked). By default the **last** number goes up (1.2.3 → 1.2.4).
Tick one box to bump a different number instead:

- [ ] Bump the **first** number — big changes (1.2.3 → 2.0.0) <!-- bump:major -->
